SPEC-subdocument-plugin-contract.md:
- UI half code block:
  - Add `PluginSection` (`id`: an anchor id unique on the page, namespaced `page-<type>-<section>`; `label`: nav text) and the optional `sections?: readonly PluginSection[]` member on `SubDocumentPlugin`, with a one-line comment saying a plugin without it gets only its page pill (D-02, D-03).
  - Change the checklist's load example to `m.<Type>Editor`, matching the project's component class naming (e.g. `IntimacyEditor`).
- Editor rules: add a rule that every declared section id must exist in the editor DOM in both modes and carry `scroll-margin-top` (D-03).
- Host behaviour bullets (replace the confirm and nav wording):
  - SubDocHost renders a slim chapter title bar, not an enclosing card: icon, displayName, 18+ badge, drag handle, ▲ ▼, remove. In view mode it shows only the title and the adult badge. The plugin renders its own cards below; there are no nested cards (D-01).
  - The editor mounts through `PluginOutlet` inside `@defer (on viewport)`.
  - Remove has no confirm. The page is removed at once and a snackbar "<displayName> removed" with an Undo action shows for about 8 s. Undo re-inserts the page at its original index with its original data, for the same character only. The undo payload lives in memory only: navigating away, reloading or the toast expiring discards it. Removal and undo persist through normal autosave. Every removal shows the undo, including a still-default page (D-06, D-07, D-08).
  - Pressing the drag handle collapses every page to its title bar for the duration of the drag. After a drop or cancel, pages expand and the viewport scrolls to the moved page. ▲ ▼ never collapse (D-05).
  - The section nav shows a header pill, then per page a page pill followed by that page's section pills. It is shown whenever the character has at least one page and hidden when it has none (D-02, D-04).
  - A new character has no pages. "+ Add page" sits below the last page and opens a picker of the available types (icon, displayName, description, 18+ badge), as a bottom sheet under 700 px. Selecting a row appends the page. With no pages, the line "This dossier has no pages yet." sits above the control. The control is hidden (not disabled) when every type is present (D-09 to D-12).
- "What counts as a host change": leave unchanged.

SPEC-design-system.md:
- §4.2 Section nav anatomy: after the header pill, each page pill is followed by that page's section pills. Section pills use `--text-muted`, mono at 10px, a middle dot "·" before the label, no border until current, and the same 44 px hit area. Scroll-spy sets `aria-current="true"` on whichever page or section pill is in view (the topmost element whose top is at or below the nav bottom). States line: "hidden in print and when the character has no pages" (D-02, D-04). Add: `scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--nav-height) + 12px)` applies to page title bars and plugin section cards (D-03).
- §4.3 Card: replace the "*New*: a title bar row above h2" sentence. The page title bar is a slim chapter bar outside the plugin's cards: icon, display name (h2), 18+ badge, drag handle, ▲ ▼, remove. View mode keeps only the title and badge. While a drag is active every page collapses to this bar (D-01, D-05).
- §4.7 Meter Keyboard: replace with the reconciled mapping (identical text is repeated in SPEC-intimacy-dossier):
  - `role="radiogroup"` with `aria-label="Experience: <card name>"` or `"Enjoyment: <card name>"`.
  - Each glyph is `role="radio"` with `aria-label` = its level word, `aria-checked` true only for the current level.
  - Roving tabindex (ARIA APG radio group): the checked glyph, or the first glyph when unset, has `tabindex="0"`; all others `-1`.
  - ArrowRight/ArrowDown move focus to and check the next level; ArrowLeft/ArrowUp the previous; both clamp at the ends (no wrap, because wrapping from the top level to the bottom one would silently rewrite a rating).
  - Home/End check the first or last level.
  - Space checks the focused glyph when it is not checked, and clears to unset when it is.
  - Delete and Backspace clear to unset.
  - Clicking the current level clears it.
  - The word line under the meter is `aria-live="polite"`: it shows the level word, and after a clear it announces "Cleared" through visually hidden text.
  - The focus ring is drawn on the group (`.meter:has(:focus-visible)`) while DOM focus sits on the glyph.
  - Each glyph's hit area is at least 24 × 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8) around a 12 px visual glyph. `.meter-top` wraps the meter under its label on narrow cards.
- §4.6 Rating card view state: an unset card is at 70 % opacity. The capacity row is hidden in view mode when both capacity strings are empty.
- §4.12 Toast: add an optional action button (label text, e.g. "Undo") rendered after the message. Activating it runs the action and dismisses the toast. Undo toasts last 8 s (D-06).

SPEC-intimacy-dossier.md:
- Accessibility section: replace the paragraph with the same reconciled mapping as §4.7 (group label form 'Experience: <card name>', roving tabindex, arrows clamp, Home/End, Space check-or-clear, Delete/Backspace, 'Cleared' announcement, live word line).
- View mode section: add that empty capacity fields collapse (the row hides when both are empty), unset rating cards render at 70 % opacity, and section cards keep their anchor ids `page-intimacy-anatomy`, `page-intimacy-themes`, `page-intimacy-bdsm`, `page-intimacy-preferences` in both modes.
  </action>
